summary: Round 2 testing focused on ARIA avatar + Sarvam multilingual TTS. All 9 backend tests executed via pytest, 8 passed. TTS endpoint verified in English, Hindi (Devanagari translation confirmed), Tamil, Hinglish; cache hit-path and 422 validation both green. Frontend avatar assistant verified end-to-end: greeting w/ time-based prefix + Archi mention, language dropdown switches label to हिंदी and fires POST /api/tts with language='hindi', project card 01 click updates bubble to 'Multi-Agent... six-agent pipeline' summary and triggers /api/tts. Hero regression: no Hugging Face button, GitHub+LinkedIn links present, description mentions Python and Agentic. Only failure: /api/contact returned 502 (Emergent email integration returned 401 Unauthorized upstream) — regression from iter 1, unrelated to this feature round.

minor.issue: Returns 502 — upstream Emergent email API responds 401 Unauthorized ('Client error 401 for url https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send'). Likely EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY expired/rotated or rate-limited. Passed in iteration 1, now failing. Message is still persisted in Mongo; only email delivery is broken.

integration_issues.issue: No /api/tts network call observed within 7s of page load in headless run (bubble text renders correctly, but the auto-speak fetch did not fire in this run). Non-blocking because manual language change + project click both trigger /api/tts as expected; could be React StrictMode double-mount cancelling the initial setTimeout, or headless environment quirk. Worth a quick look but not user-visible.

action_items: Investigate /api/contact 502: verify EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is still valid; upstream returned 401 Unauthorized. Not caused by this feature round but needs a fix before ship.
(Optional) Confirm greeting auto-TTS fires on real page load; headless didn't capture the initial POST /api/tts although bubble text rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 318 lines with TTS/email/chat all in one module — approaching split threshold; consider extracting tts and email routers.
translate_text uses a fresh Claude session per call which adds latency and cost for every non-English, non-cached TTS. Consider caching the translation separately or batching.
TTS cache is keyed on raw text+language but has no TTL/eviction — Mongo tts_cache will grow unboundedly.

Frontend Avatar.jsx useEffect for greeting has empty deps array but references doSpeak — works but ESLint would warn; also under React StrictMode dev double-invocation, the setTimeout is scheduled twice (greetedRef guards it, good).
seed_data_creation: None (test contact row inserted into contact_messages before 502; test entries used TEST_ prefix)

Only remaining bug is /api/contact 502 from Emergent email 401 — regression from iter 1. All avatar UI selectors (avatar-assistant, avatar-bubble, avatar-language-toggle, avatar-language-menu, avatar-lang-*, avatar-replay, avatar-mute, avatar-bubble-close, avatar-reopen, project-card-01) confirmed present and clickable.
rca of the issue: Contact 502 → backend log: 'Contact email send failed: Client error 401 Unauthorized for url https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send'. Root cause is upstream auth failure at Emergent email integration (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY invalid/expired). Reproduction: POST /api/contact with any valid EmailStr payload → server persists row → httpx POST to /api/v1/email/send raises HTTPStatusError → server returns 502. Mitigation: refresh EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY in /app/backend/.env and restart backend.
